Shree Enterprise offers complete solar energy solutions for homes and small businesses across Talala, Mangrol, and Junagadh. Their solar installations range between 2.5kW, 3kW, and 5kW capacity. They use high-efficiency mono PERC panels from trusted brands like Adani Solar and Waaree Energies. Solar installation includes: Free site survey, load calculation, roof inspection, and subsidy consultation. Complete documentation for PM Surya Ghar Government Subsidy Scheme. Installation of solar panels, mounting structures, DC wiring, AC wiring, inverter configuration, and grounding. Assistance with net-meter application and approval through DISCOM. Post-installation support and system maintenance. Average output: 2.5kW produces 10 units/day. 3kW produces 12–14 units/day. 5kW produces 20+ units/day. Savings: Households typically save ₹1,500–₹4,000 monthly depending on system size. Government Subsidy: Under PM Surya Ghar Yojana, customers can receive: ₹18,000 per kW up to 3kW, ₹9,000 per additi

2–4 days. DISCOM Inspection: 1–2 days. Total time: 5–10 working days. Solar systems support inverters, refrigerators, TVs, lights, ACs, and fans. Hybrid inverters work even with weak grid supply in villages. Panels have a life of 25+ years and require minimal cleaning. Shree Enterprise ensures transparent pricing, proper installation, and long-term reliability. Customers receive a detailed quote, brand information, and warranty documents.

Decoration offerings include: Wedding mandap with floral or thematic setups. Engagement and reception stage decoration. Haldi and mehndi themes with yellow drapes, marigold flowers, umbrellas, and props. Birthday themes with balloons, backdrop frames, character cutouts, and lighting. Entry gate decoration for weddings and social events. Photo booth and selfie zone designs. Complete lighting arrangements with LED par cans, fairy lights, and spotlights. Special event themes such as Floral Paradise, Golden Royal Theme, Eco-Traditional, Modern Minimalist, and Color Pop for kids.
